battle.name: 大儀之戰
battle.brief: 紹興四年（一一三四年）三月，金以粘罕、完顏宗弼、完顏婁室三路大舉南侵，宋廷乘勢反攻，淮東、淮西與襄漢三路並進。淮南宋軍收復宿泗、進抵大儀一帶，與金人騎兵遭遇而失利，反攻全線隨即瓦解，襄陽陷落。配重投石車這類攻城器械在攻守兩端都未能扭轉戰局，工程與指揮的失序才是真正決定勝負之處。

kit.name: 配重投石車
kit.history: 長臂配重把石頭甩過城牆。工程比攻城武器更早決定勝負。

countries: 交戰的雙方是女真金國與南宋。金方由金主完顏旻坐鎮中都（今北京），以左副元帥粘罕（完顏宗翰）、右副元帥完顏宗弼（兀朮）、完顏婁室分領三路大軍：粘罕出河東，趨陝西蜀口；宗弼自河南、山東兩路南下，指向淮西、淮南；婁室自河東道南下，趨襄漢。金廷在中原仍倚僞齊劉豫的漢軍作先鋒與守備，契丹、奚、渤海諸部人馬亦被編入軍伍，糧秣則自河北、山東、山西四處徵集。金方指揮系統以元帥府為樞，各路大軍可自定方嚮，卻彼此不相互呼應，這既是進攻時的銳利之處，也是日後各自退守的原因。南宋方面，紹興四年朝廷以樞密使唐檜總攝軍務，參知政事趙鼎佐之，各路邊軍分屬宣撫使與統制：淮西、淮東由張俊、韓世忠、劉錫分領，襄漢一線歸趙鼎，川陝由吳玠、吳璘鎮守，湖北路另遣岳飛為招討使。金廷在主戰與主和之間爭執不休，反攻計畫分頭下達，卻沒有一份統一的戰術方案與集中的指揮權，戰役因此從一開始就各打各的。
countriesEn: The two sides were the Jurchen Jin state and the Southern Song. On the Jin side the ruler, Wanyan Min, sat at Zhongdu (modern Beijing), and the army was divided among three commanders: the left vice-commander Nahan (Wanyan Zonghan), the right vice-commander Wanyan Zongbi (Wuzhu), and Wanyan Louzhu. Nahan came out of Hedong and pressed toward the Sichuan front; Zongbi marched south from Henan and Shandong, aiming at the Huai west and the Huai east; Louzhu came down the Hedong road toward Xiangyang and Han. The Jin court still relied on the Han troops of the puppet state of Qi under Liu Yu as vanguard and garrison in the Central Plains, and men from the Khitan, Xi and Bohai peoples were folded into the armies, while grain was levied from Hebei, Shandong and Shanxi alike. The Jin command system turned on the marshals' headquarters: each column was free to choose its own line of march, and the columns did not cover one another. That was the source of the speed of the offensive, and equally the reason each of them fell back on its own when the attack ran out of steam. On the Song side, in the fourth year of Shaoxing the court put the whole business of war under the Privy Councillor Tang Hui, assisted by the Vice Minister of State Zhao Ding, and the frontier armies were distributed among the pacifying commissioners and the commanders: Zhang Jun, Han Shizhong and Liu Xi took the Huai west and the Huai east; Zhao Ding held the Xiangyang and Han front; Wu Jie and Wu Lin guarded the Sichuan and Shaanxi passes; and Yue Fei was sent to Hubei as recruiting and pacifying commissioner. The Song court was torn between the war party and the peace party, the counter-offensive was ordered out in pieces, and no single plan of battle united them.
people: 關鍵人物分屬兩方。金方的核心是完顏宗弼：紹興四年他以右副元帥之身統攝中路大軍，銳意南下，志在乘宋廷內爭之際盡取淮南與襄漢；粘罕為左副元帥，與宗弼爭權，兩人互不相讓，宗弼遂藉完顏希尹之力除掉粘罕，希尹旋亦被宗弼以謀反之名誅殺，軍中自此只聽宗弼一人號令。完顏婁室領西路趨襄漢，攻城器械與主力都集中在那一路，最終乘亂攻破襄陽。宋方的關鍵人物更多。樞密使唐檜力主趁金人新敗、內部不整之際反攻，並自領中路都統；參知政事趙鼎主西路，志在襄陽；張俊、韓世忠各領一軍在江淮一線；劉錫以統制之身分率順昌、潁昌之兵收復宿州、泗州，進抵大儀，是這次反攻最前線的指揮者。吳玠、吳璘在蜀口以「混元一氣陣」大破金兵，穩住西北一翼。湖北招討使岳飛以輕兵疾進，收復襄陽六郡，替朝廷在荊襄重新立下腳點。至於大儀一役的宋方主將，各家記載不一，或稱劉錫，或歸於張俊、韓世忠所部，可以確定的是淮南宋軍在宿泗得手之後仍向前推進，進入金人預設的包抄位置，統帥各部互不呼應，潰散時也無人能收束隊伍。
peopleEn: The decisive figures stand on both sides. At the centre of the Jin side is Wanyan Zongbi: in the fourth year of Shaoxing, as right vice-commander he took charge of the central column, pressed south without pause, and aimed to seize the Huai and Xiangyang while the Song court was absorbed in its own quarrels. Nahan, the left vice-commander, was in conflict with him over command, and the two did not support one another; Zongbi therefore had Wanyan Xiyin remove Nahan, and Xiyin was himself killed by Zongbi on a charge of plotting rebellion, after which the army obeyed Zongbi alone. Wanyan Louzhu led the western column against Xiangyang and Han, where the siege train and the mass of the troops were concentrated, and he duly took Xiangyang amid the confusion. The Song side has more of them. The Privy Councillor Tang Hui pressed for a counter-offensive on the ground that the Jin had just suffered a reverse and were still divided among themselves, and he took the central command himself; the Vice Minister Zhao Ding took the western line in the direction of Xiangyang; Zhang Jun and Han Shizhong each led a body in the river country; and Liu Xi, as commander, led the men of Shunchang and Yingchang, recovered Suzhou and Sizhou, and pushed forward to Dayi, which made him the most forward commander of the counter-offensive. Wu Jie and Wu Lin broke the Jin at Xianguan in the Sichuan passes with the 'Mixed-Origin One-Ri' formation, holding the north-western wing steady. Yue Fei, recruiting commissioner for Hubei, moved in fast with light troops, recovered the six prefectures of Xiangyang, and set a new footing for the court in Jing and Xiang. As for the Song commander at Dayi, the records differ, some naming Liu Xi, others assigning the action to the men of Zhang Jun or Han Shizhong; what can be established is that the troops of the Huai, having won Suzhou and Sizhou, pressed on into a position the Jin had prepared for encirclement, that the commanders did not support one another, and that no one was able to rally the broken ranks.
kits: 卡面這件配重投石車在這場戰爭裡的位置，是攻城與守砦兩端的中型工程器械。中國式的配重投石車在宋代兵書《武經總要》中已有圖樣，軍中稱砲車或霹靂車，長臂一端繫石、一端懸配重，拋出的石彈重以數十斤至百餘斤計，專打城頭、垛口與密集結陣的步卒。宋軍在江淮各寨修築堡壘時以它壓制逼近的敵軍，攻城時則用來對付城頭弓弩手；金軍在襄漢一線不但備有雲梯、攻城塔、撞竿與柴車，攻城失利後還曾學用宋人的砲車反擊，說明這類器械在雙方體系中都不可或缺。戰場上真正密集出現的是騎兵：金人南侵以女真、奚、契丹組成的重騎為主力，配以輕騎抄截，馬匹數量龐大，軍中備大量挽馬與草料。漢地所募的鄉兵與禁軍步卒則以長槍、大刀、弓弩列陣，結陣時以弩手壓制騎兵衝鋒，靠壘土、鹿角與拒馬阻滯馬匹。糧秣運轉同樣吃重，金軍由河北、山東沿汴河、泗水與淮水轉運，宋軍則靠江淮漕運與地方倉儲維持遠征隊伍，運力不足正是反攻無法持久的底層原因。
kitsEn: The counterweight trebuchet on the card stood in this war as a piece of middle-sized engineering on both the attacking and the defending side. The Chinese counterweight trebuchet appears in diagram in the Song military manual the Wujing Zongyao, and the armies called it a paoche or a thunder-crash chariot: a long arm with a stone at one end and a counterweight at the other, hurling stones of tens of jin up to over a hundred jin, against the heads of walls, the crenellations and the dense ranks of foot. The Song used it in the Jiang-Huai fortresses to pin down troops pressing the works, and against the bowmen on the walls when attacking; the Jin on the Xiangyang-Han line brought up ladders, siege towers, battering rams and fascines, and after their assaults failed they took to using Song paoche in reply, which shows that this class of machine was indispensable in the system of both sides. What was really dense on the battlefield was cavalry: the southern invasion of the Jin was carried by heavy cavalry drawn from the Jurchen, Xi and Khitan, with light horse sent out to cut and encircle, the number of horses enormous and the columns carrying large numbers of draught animals and fodder. The locally recruited villagers and the imperial infantry fought in close order with spear, sabre, bow and crossbow, massing the crossbowmen to hold off the charge and using earthen ramparts, abatis and cheval-de-frise to check the horses. The movement of grain was no lighter: the Jin brought supplies down by the Bian river, the Si and the Huai from Hebei and Shandong, while the Song drew on the river transport of the Jiang-Huai and on local granaries, and that shortfall of carrying power lay at the bottom of why the counter-offensive could not be sustained.
tactics: 金人的戰術是三路齊進、各自打算。粘罕出河東後轉向蜀口，企圖以重騎衝垮吳玠、吳璘的關塞；宗弼自河南、山東南下，先以騎兵游擊宋軍邊寨、斷其糧道，再集主力攻破城隘；婁室一路直取襄漢，用雲梯與攻城塔強攻，並在城下屯營久圍。三路之間沒有協同，一旦某一路受阻，另外兩路仍照原定日程推進。宋廷的反攻則把計畫分得過散：唐檜以劉錫出順昌、收宿泗，趙鼎出襄漢，張俊、韓世忠在江淮策應，吳玠、吳璘守蜀口，岳飛在荊襄待命，各路之間沒有事先約定的協同時刻，也沒有統一的戰場指揮權，任一路推進都靠自己的運氣。實際接觸時，宋軍往往在金騎兵主力到達之前已渡河北上，糧道拉長而接應不來；大儀一役正是如此，淮南宋軍在宿泗得手後繼續前出，進入金人預設的包抄位置，被騎兵側擊而全軍潰散，隨後整條反攻線連鎖瓦解。守城方的技術重點在壘土與拒馬：吳璘在仙人關以長槍、盾牌層層結陣，弩手在後射壓，金人攻關的雲梯屢次被長槍隊推翻；金人攻襄陽時把攻城塔推至城下，卻屢遭火攻與砲擊。攻城與守城的勝負，最後仍舊落在工程與協同這兩件事上。
tacticsEn: The Jin method was to advance in three columns, each with its own intent. Nahan came out of Hedong and turned toward the Sichuan passes, meaning to break Wu Jie and Wu Lin with heavy horse; Zongbi came down from Henan and Shandong, first sending cavalry to harry the Song frontier camps and cut their supply, then massing his main force to break the passes; Louzhu went straight for Xiangyang and Han, pressing the attack with ladders and siege towers and sitting under the city in a long siege. The three columns did not coordinate, and when one of them was checked the other two went on with the timetable they had set themselves. The Song plan of counter-attack was spread too thin: Tang Hui sent Liu Xi out from Shunchang to take Suzhou and Sizhou, Zhao Ding out towards Xiangyang, Zhang Jun and Han Shizhong to give support in the river country, Wu Jie and Wu Lin to hold the Sichuan passes, and Yue Fei to wait in Jing and Xiang, with no agreed moments for the several lines and no unified command on the field. In the actual contact, the Song often moved north across the Huai before the Jin horse had arrived, so the supply line was stretched past the point where it could be supported; that is exactly what happened at Dayi, where the troops of the Huai, having gained Suzhou and Sizhou, pressed on and entered the position the Jin had prepared for encirclement, were struck on the flank by the horse, and broke up, after which the whole line of counter-attack came apart in succession. The technical point of the defence lay in earthwork and obstacle: at Xianguan Wu Lin formed rank behind rank of spear and shield with the crossbowmen shooting from behind, and the ladders the Jin brought against the pass were overturned again and again by the spear lines. Beside Xiangyang the Jin pushed their siege towers to the foot of the wall and were met again and again by fire and by stone. Whether attack or defence, the result turned, in the end, on two things: engineering and coordination.
data: 可以核對的數字大致如下。這場戰爭自紹興四年三月金人分道南侵起，至同年冬季金軍北撤、前線重整，歷時約半年。金方三路大軍的總兵力，各家記載從十餘萬到數十萬不等，說法懸殊；其中西路攻襄漢一軍連同隨軍器械，數萬之眾是可以確定的規模。宋方反攻的兵力同樣分散：劉錫所領順昌、潁昌兵為數萬之眾，張俊、韓世忠兩軍各領數萬，全線合計約十餘萬的說法常見於史書，但缺具體編制。時間點也有零星記載：紹興四年正月吳璘於仙人關大敗金兵，是南進的第一記挫折；同年三四月宋軍收復宿州、泗州，兵鋒進抵大儀一帶隨即受挫；同年冬襄陽失守，岳飛收復襄陽六郡。金廷內部在同一年發生完顏宗翰被誅、完顏希尹被殺兩起變故，宗弼自此獨攬兵權。和議在紹興五年四月達成，主要條款為宋向金稱臣、割唐鄧兩州、歲貢銀絹各二十五萬，並追回已封官爵、罷免韓世忠等大將兵權，兩國邊界其後仍以淮水為界。至於大儀一役本身的細節，現存記載有限：戰史多只概言宋軍進至大儀而敗，參戰序列與損耗數字都難以確證，只能就三路大戰的整體部署推想。
dataEn: The figures that can be checked run roughly as follows. The war opened in the third month of the fourth year of Shaoxing, when the Jin advanced in several columns, and ran until the winter of the same year, when their armies fell back and the front was reformed, a matter of about half a year. The total strength of the three Jin columns is given in the records from a little over a hundred thousand to several hundred thousand, the statements being very far apart; for the western column against Xiangyang and Han, several tens of thousands of men with their siege train is a scale that can be accepted. The Song forces were dispersed in the same way: the men of Shunchang and Yingchang under Liu Xi were a few tens of thousands, the armies of Zhang Jun and Han Shizhong several tens of thousands each, and the figure of something over a hundred thousand for the whole line is commonly given in the histories, though no establishment is attached to it. There are scattered dates: in the first month of the fourth year of Shaoxing Wu Lin destroyed the Jin at Xianguan, the first reverse for the southern advance; in the third and fourth months the Song took Suzhou and Sizhou and their spear reached the line of Dayi, where it was checked; and in the winter of the same year Xiangyang fell and Yue Fei recovered the six prefectures of Xiangyang. Within the Jin court two disturbances occurred in the same year, the killing of Nahan and the killing of Xiyin, after which Zongbi held the military power alone. The settlement was concluded in the fourth month of the fifth year of Shaoxing, its principal terms being that the Song should call itself a subject, that Tang and Deng should be ceded, and that silver and silk should be paid yearly to the value of two hundred and fifty thousand each, together with the withdrawal of offices already conferred and the removal from command of generals such as Han Shizhong; the frontier between the two states was afterwards still drawn along the Huai. As for the engagement at Dayi itself, the surviving record is thin: the chronicles say little more than that the Song reached Dayi and were beaten, and the order of battle and the losses there cannot be established, so the whole engagement can only be reconstructed from the disposition of the three great columns.
cause: 打起上來的直接起因，是紹興三年宋金在西北一線的得手激起了反攻的念頭，也激起了金方的反擊。吳玠、吳璘在和尚原、仙人關一帶連敗金兵，宋廷以為金人新敗、元氣未復，於是紹興四年春由樞密使唐檜主持三路反攻，試圖趁金廷內部粘罕與宗弼爭權而收復淮西、淮東與襄漢。這一計劃在執行中一一落空。淮西總領劉光世所部在部將陳積的叛亂中當夜潰散，數萬人散為盜賊，朝廷震動，張俊隨即被罷；反攻尚未成勢，負責東路的名將也久無音訊，淮南兵力只剩張俊、韓世忠所部。與此同時，金廷的政爭以最殘酷的方式收場，完顏希尹殺粘罕，宗弼又殺希尹，然後以追討叛黨的名義在河南、山東、淮南大舉用兵，把原定的守勢翻成攻勢。南方朝廷對金人三路齊進的判斷也完全錯誤：他們以為金人必攻川陝，卻不知道金人同時要取襄漢、要掃平淮北，於是兵力被分到三處，每一處都不足以決戰，戰爭就這樣從反攻變成拉鋸，最後又回到和議的舊路。
causeEn: The immediate occasion of the fighting was that the Song success in the north-west in the third year of Shaoxing raised the wish for a counter-offensive, and with it the wish of the Jin to strike back. Wu Jie and Wu Lin had beaten the Jin repeatedly at Shangyuan and Xianguan, and the court believed that the enemy was still reeling from those blows and had not recovered; so in the spring of the fourth year of Shaoxing the Privy Councillor Tang Hui set three columns in motion, hoping to take advantage of the quarrel between Nahan and Zongbi at the Jin court and to recover the Huai west, the Huai east and Xiangyang. The plan came apart one part after another. The troops of the Huai west under the general pacifier Liu Guangshi broke up overnight in the mutiny of his commander Chen Ji, several tens of thousands scattering as bandits, the court was shaken, and Zhang Jun was removed. The counter-offensive had scarcely begun when the commander responsible for the eastern line fell silent for a long time, and the forces in the Huai were reduced to the armies of Zhang Jun and Han Shizhong. Meanwhile the quarrel inside the Jin court closed in the most brutal way: Xiyin killed Nahan, Zongbi killed Xiyin, and then, in the name of hunting down rebels, the great columns were sent into Henan, Shandong and the Huai, turning a defensive posture into an offensive one. The southern court's reading of the three-pronged advance was simply wrong: they thought the Jin would strike at the Sichuan and Shaanxi front, not knowing that the Jin meant to take Xiangyang and Han at the same time and to sweep the north of the Huai clean. The troops were therefore scattered into three places, none strong enough to decide a battle, and the war turned from an offensive into a long stalemate, and finally back onto the old road of negotiation.
impact: 這場戰爭的長遠影響，比大儀一役本身的勝負更大。反攻失敗之後，北方義軍在中原的經營中斷，僞齊的漢軍在兩淮站不住腳，宿泗一帶重歸金人，宋朝收復的城池又逐一淪陷。但正因為襄漢一度失守，朝廷才把荊襄方向看得比淮南更急，岳飛得以在紹興四年冬天收復襄陽六郡，進而在鄂西、襄北建立起一個可以屯兵、可以製茶的後方基地，後來北伐的兵源與糧秣很大一部分就出自這個基地。反攻計畫的破滅也改變了朝堂的力量對比：唐檜借和議逐步收回兵權，岳飛、韓世忠、張浚等一輩將領相繼去職，紹興五年以後的對金政策由攻轉為守，邊界長期固定在淮水一線，兩國之間維持了長期而脆弱的和平，直到三十年後海路被開、蒙古南下才被打破。技術面上，這場戰爭再次印證攻城器械的極限：金人在襄陽用盡雲梯、攻城塔與石砲，仍舊攻不下被長期經營的城防；宋人在宿泗得手卻守不住收復的城池。真正決定勝負的，是能不能把工程、糧道與指揮連成一條線；配重投石車之類能越過城牆的器械，只是這條線上的一環。
impactEn: The long-run effect of this war was greater than the outcome of the engagement at Dayi itself. The organisation of northern loyalists in the Central Plains was broken off, the Han troops of the puppet state of Qi could not hold their ground in the Two Huai, and places such as Suzhou and Sizhou went back to the Jin, city by city. But precisely because Xiangyang and Han were lost for a time, the court came to treat the Jing-Xiang direction as more urgent than the Huai, and Yue Fei was able to recover the six prefectures of Xiangyang in the winter of the fourth year of Shaoxing; a rear base in which troops could be quartered and tea could be produced was thereby established in western Hubei and northern Xiang, and much of the men and grain of the later northern expeditions came out of it. The ruin of the counter-offensive also altered the balance of force at court: Tang Hui used the settlement to draw the military authority back to himself, and generals of the generation of Yue Fei, Han Shizhong and Zhang Jun were removed from their commands in turn; after the fifth year of Shaoxing the policy towards the Jin changed from attack to defence, the frontier stood for a long time along the Huai, and a long and fragile peace was kept between the two states, unbroken until the sea route was opened and the Mongols came south thirty years later. In technical terms the war confirmed once more the limit of siege engines: the Jin used up ladders, siege towers and stone throwers at Xiangyang and still could not take a city that had been built up over a long time, while the Song with their paoche, their ramparts and their crossbow formations could not hold the two cities they had just recovered in the Huai. What decided the outcome was whether engineering, supply and command could be joined into one unbroken line, and a machine like the counterweight trebuchet that could throw a stone over a wall was only one link in that line.
result: 結果是宋方三路反攻全面瓦解。淮南宋軍在宿泗得手後進抵大儀一帶，遭金人騎兵側擊，潰散之後，宿州、泗州等新收復的城池相繼失守，淮南防線退回淮水以南；西路襄漢方向失守更早，金軍長驅入襄陽，宋廷經營荊襄十年的成果幾乎掃地；只有川陝一線因為仙人關的勝利而守住，吳玠、吳璘得以維持關陝的基本盤。紹興四年冬天，岳飛率兵收復襄陽六郡，把襄陽、隨州、郢州一線重新拿回，荊襄的旗幟換了顏色，但那只是收復失地，不是反攻的開始。金人的攻勢也在同一時間停了下來：粘罕被誅、希尹被殺、宗弼獨攬兵權，加上西北與淮南兩線都沒有取得決定性勝利，紹興五年四月宋金訂下和議，宋稱臣、割唐鄧、歲貢銀絹各二十五萬，韓世忠、張浚等解職，邊界以淮水為界劃定。從裝備的角度看，這場戰爭給出的答案是殘酷的：金人備有雲梯、攻城塔、石砲與強大的騎兵，仍然拿不下襄陽；宋人有砲車、有壘土、有弩陣，仍然守不住淮南新得的兩座城。勝負之數，不在器械清單，而在誰能把器械、糧秣與指揮拼成一條不斷的線。
resultEn: The result was the complete collapse of the three-column counter-offensive. Having gained Suzhou and Sizhou, the Song troops of the Huai pushed on to the line of Dayi, were struck on the flank by Jin horse and broke up; the towns they had just taken, Suzhou and Sizhou among them, were lost in turn, and the line of defence in the Huai fell back south of the river. The western line at Xiangyang and Han fell earlier, the Jin drove into Xiangyang, and the work the Song had done in Jing and Xiang over ten years was swept away; only the Sichuan and Shaanxi line held, thanks to the victory at Xianguan, and Wu Jie and Wu Lin were able to keep the basic base of the passes. In the winter of the fourth year of Shaoxing Yue Fei led his men and recovered the six prefectures of Xiangyang, taking back the line of Xiangyang, Suizhou and Yingzhou, so that the banners of Jing and Xiang changed hands; but that was the recovery of lost ground, not the beginning of an offensive. The Jin advance stopped at the same time: Nahan was killed, Xiyin was killed, Zongbi took the military power alone, and neither the north-west nor the Huai gave them a decisive success. In the fourth month of the fifth year of Shaoxing the Song and the Jin concluded their settlement, the Song calling itself a subject, ceding Tang and Deng and paying silver and silk to the value of two hundred and fifty thousand each, with Han Shizhong, Zhang Jun and others relieved of their commands, and the frontier marked out along the Huai. As to the equipment, the answer this war gives is a hard one: the Jin had ladders, siege towers, stone throwers and powerful cavalry, and still could not take Xiangyang; the Song had their paoche, their earthworks and their crossbow formations, and still could not hold the two towns in the Huai they had just gained. The arithmetic of victory does not lie in the list of weapons but in who can weld weapons, grain and command into a single unbroken line.
